findings.source_location: L05 section 3 near displayed triality-group action after equation (6)
findings.source_behavior: For elements r of Tri(D), a linear transformation of the three role carriers sends (v,psi,chi) to (v',psi',chi') preserving T(v',psi',chi')=T(v,psi,chi). The source presents an actual transformation/invariant relation, not only a category name.
findings.omission: L132 G1 0.2 has source role atoms and wrappers for automorphism/rotation/triality, but no separately recoverable Tri(D) membership-to-linear-action/invariant-T formula or group carrier. L131 only closes explicit selected generalized-reflection compositions.
findings.required_fidelity: Preserve linear three-role action with T equality and group/source carrier scope; do not assert an unsupported all-and-only characterization or group integration theorem.

findings.source_location: L05 section 3 paragraph immediately preceding triality Lie-algebra equation
findings.source_behavior: Tri(D) includes ordinary rotations and triality automorphisms.
findings.omission: L132 G1 0.2 records distinct category atoms and same/different-type structural aliases, but no source inclusion/member incidence connecting those classes to Tri(D).
findings.required_fidelity: Add source inclusion relations without inventing pairwise disjointness or automatic equivalence between all group elements and a subset of generators.

findings.source_location: L05 section 3 displayed infinitesimal triality-algebra equation immediately before the table of tri(C), tri(H), tri(O) and split analogues
findings.source_behavior: The source identifies tri(D) as the Lie algebra of Tri(D) and imposes T(Rv,psi,chi)+T(v,Rpsi,chi)+T(v,psi,Rchi)=0 on an infinitesimal three-role generator R. The source also gives explicit generator actions.
findings.omission: L132 G1 0.2 enumerates Lie-carrier bracket tables and metric-skew realizations, but not the generator-action incidence or the three-term infinitesimal T-invariance equality, nor an exact link to the triality transformation carrier.
findings.required_fidelity: Preserve all three derivative/action positions, the zero equality, source role typing, source Lie-carrier link, and scope. Do not infer the Lie-algebra/group correspondence from a familiar name or from the finite Lie-table presentation.
